rev.t: A nice cute cafe, preferably for tea totalers or maybe first dates. The food is really good, very tasty,  and the portion size is a lot. The first floor is a bit noise during traffic hours, but the ground floor is silent and really calm. …
Lazy Suzy Café is a small and cozy place with a nice, relaxed vibe. They offer a good variety of food options to choose from. …

The food here wasn’t really good. The fish fingers were quite bad—I think the fish was old, and it was very hard to bite. The chicken patty in the burger was also tough and not enjoyable. The chicken steak was just okay, nothing special. …
